description.en: The name of the swimlane group.

description.zh: 工作负载对应的标签，目前固定为`ASM_TRAFFIC_TAG`。
description.en: The label of the workload. The value is fixed to `ASM_TRAFFIC_TAG`.

description.zh: 服务工作负载对应的Label标签：`ASM_TRAFFIC_TAG`的取值。
description.en: The value of the `ASM_TRAFFIC_TAG` label for the service workload.

description.zh: 泳道关联的服务列表，取值为JSON数组，单个服务格式为`$集群名称/$集群ID/$Namespace/$serviceName`。
description.en: The list of services to associate with the swimlane. The value is a JSON array. The format for a single service is `$ClusterName/$ClusterID/$Namespace/$ServiceName`.
